evidence.contradiction_scope: Challenges to candidate or stronger universal rules, not necessarily to the final qualified wording.
data_quality_notes: Source extractions reviewed; original videos were not reopened during synthesis.
Both dedicated player-role fields are empty in all input records; roles remain unknown except where explicit narrative evidence is cited.
Sample win rate is a property of selected footage, not expected ladder performance.
Absent events are unknown unless the record explicitly establishes availability or absence.
A reported enemy kill can occur after a friendly death; the round result is stored separately.
8 records carry source quality flags; consult evidence and exceptions before treating a claim as footage-verified.

facts.sequence_limit: Endpoints only. No intermediate swap timing, causal sequence, or survival at the enemy death is inferred by this computation.

facts.resource_count_limit: Exact source-listed labels, deduplicated within each match. They include uncertain or offensive entries and are not verified forced-resource frequencies.
facts.cc_count_limit: Literal mentions in observed notes, including negated/uncertain/post-death mentions. These are search aids, not counts of landed CC.
facts.recovery_count_limit: Field coverage only: texts may explicitly say no reset. Not a reset-event rate.

conversion.text: Continue Warrior if the health deficit persists; otherwise commit Priest during useful Warrior control and renew damage after the healer escape.

reset.text: A healed first Priest attempt can be followed by recovery, renewed Warrior Fear/Sap and another Priest commitment.
